Quote it exactly. 2) Find the capability dex, use its search to look for 'browser' — list the matching capabilities with their numbers. 3) Open the FAQ and read two entries — summarize each in one line. 4) Visit /blog and open the latest post — its exact title and date? 5) Throughout, watch the console and network: report ANY console errors or failed network requests you observed (exact messages). Report concisely under the headings: Hero / Install command / Dex browser entries / FAQ / Blog / Errors.
